question: 在点数和目标形态变化时，哪些近似会损害分类稳定性？能否针对这些误差，用更合适的统计表示、精度分配和共享计算结构，获得优于现有实现的质量—成本取舍？
user_decisions: Software convergence first; no new RTL/SoC/bitstream/board work
Include true 1/2-point observations and report separately

data.history: Same sequence/sensor/GT track, up to six preceding retained >=3-point observations plus current; sparse observations do not update history
data.label: Original target IDs 0,1,2,3,7,8 with nonempty GT track; majority original ID, 7/8->0 and others->1; ties use minimum ID as before

training.loss: Class-weighted cross entropy; weights computed from the common train-only expected mixture
training.view_counts: 178890 clean, 89445 sparse; quarter and center alternate 44722/44723 on odd/even epochs; exact intended mixture over each two epochs
training.matching: 12 strata = binary class x current count 1/2 x prior retained history 0/1..5/6; common support only; natural stratum proportions; largest-remainder quotas, same quotas and order across policies
training.draws: Without replacement for retained rows per epoch; sparse pool sampling with replacement within each matched stratum; separate deterministic RNGs
training.calibration: 16384 common train-only rows: 8192 clean, 2048 quarter, 2048 central, 2048 synthetic, 2048 natural; same identities for both coverage policies and representations
training.normalization: Exact expected common mixture moments: 0.5 clean +0.125 quarter +0.125 central +0.125 matched synthetic +0.125 matched natural; folded into first layer
training.scales: Previous train-only per-feature scales unchanged; QAT scales frozen once before QAT; final epoch60 only
training.replicate_rule: All three seeds; no validation-selected checkpoint, no extra seeds or loss coefficients

evaluation.groups: N, original input shape, N x shape, current point count, current range <=20/20..40/>40 and history 0/1..5/6; supported >=100 rows, >=3 sequences and both labels
evaluation.composite: equal mean of clean, mean(quarter0,quarter1,quarter2), central_half, sparse_single, sparse_context
evaluation.bootstrap: 2000 paired whole-sequence resamples with fixed RNG; report each seed and three-seed mean; exploratory only
evaluation.fallback: A main baseline, B difficult-condition alternative if no new candidate passes

precision.selection: lowest passing reciprocal width; otherwise24; rerun software gates with selected precision before promotion

stop: No training before identity/history/label/numerical preflight PASS. Halt dependent work on a real mismatch or stage budget exhaustion, retain evidence. After 12 runs complete all analysis, selection, C package, paper text and backups; no extra training.
interpretation: Historical validation is development data. Matched true/synthetic pools control listed strata, not all distribution differences. No new-algorithm originality or FPGA cost claims. Single-executor review, not independent reviewer.
